features.quote: No human mid-run abortion except for sandbox safety violations (e.g., container escape attempts). Cost overruns are accepted data points.
features.justification_quote: Cost overruns are accepted data points.

features.quote: Any mode reaching L2 constitutes a confirmed induction event.
Escape Rate: % of induced runs that spontaneously stabilize (no instability signals for ≥5 consecutive turns after L2). Tracked; not a pass/fail gate.
